blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Here are INQToday’s top stories this afternoon. The prosecution at the International Criminal Court (ICC) seeks to present three witnesses to establish alleged killings linked to the Duterte administration’s war on drugs. The Philippine National Police welcomes Malacañang’s challenge, vowing no special treatment for former police chief and Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa as authorities pursue his arrest. And a new OCTA Research survey shows Vice President Sara Duterte’s lead over former Vice President Leni Robredo narrowing to seven percentage points in a hypothetical 2028 presidential matchup. /dp READ: Sara Duterte, Leni Robredo gap narrows in OCTA presidential survey...
